verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs say it runs variance analysis on the same platform where the budget is built and helps flag the reasons behind gaps. Actuals can be brought in through native connectors, open APIs and scheduled imports. Nothing in the pack shows the specific workflow, though: no budget-vs-actuals breakdown by department and account, and no drill-down to the underlying transactions. missing for 10: documented department/account-level BvA reporting, transaction-level drill-down from a variance, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
